entities.title: Who may reach what
entities.summary: test/worker.test.ts calls the Worker's fetch handler with a stand-in login service, assets and rooms.
criteria: The vendored sign-in library matches its stamp
The page is served to anyone, uncached, and the bare path redirects to BASE/
Starting a room without a sign-in is 401 with the sign-in path; api/me says canHost false; a signed-in player gets 201 with a five-letter code, and api/me gives their name
With HOST_SIGN_IN none anyone starts a room; another site's origin gets 403 and a GET gets 405
The room socket needs a valid code (404), an upgrade (426) and this site's origin (403); other api paths are 404

checks.description: Six node:test cases, one per criterion.

entities.title: The Room Durable Object
entities.summary: test/room.test.ts runs Room on a fake runtime (in-memory storage, alarm and sockets) with a fixed clock and random source.
criteria: A room is created once; a second create for its code is 409
The host joins with the token; guests join by name, and a reload with the stored token gets the same seat
A taken name, or an unknown token without a name, is refused; no action is taken before joining
Each socket gets its own view (one stowaway, without the secret; the same secret for all others); a second tab keeps a player connected
The alarm is set for the deadline and runs out a turn; a room unchanged for a day clears its storage and closes its sockets with 4404
A removed player's socket is told so and closed with 4403
A message to a room that no longer exists closes the socket with 4404

checks.description: Seven node:test cases, one per criterion.

notChecked: The real Cloudflare runtime: hibernation, alarms and storage are faked.
